# Youth Notion

> Youth Notion is a youth-led organization based in Maijdee, Noakhali, Bangladesh. It works to empower young people through education, civic awareness, technology, and community action.

## About

Youth Notion aims to help young people become self-reliant, responsible citizens and active contributors to national development. Its work includes education and career guidance, technical and vocational skills, civic responsibility, and research into challenges affecting young people.
